title: Animakind Context Injection and State Hydration Template
description: What the mount path hands a fresh context window: resolve the immutable UII, re-hydrate the identity state from the latest ledger commit, and mount it against the active UAB (Section 6.3, Appendix D). Carries both clocks side by side so a reader can see which one moved. A non-backward-compatible change to this protocol is a MAJOR UIV advance (Section 6.1).

injection_header.description: Carries the UII, its human rendering of the genesis inputs, or both.

protocol.description: The behavior-profile protocol, when one is declared. Optional for now (see system_state_hydration).

active_uii_inputs.description: Colon-delimited human rendering of the genesis inputs; resolvable, not authoritative (Section 4.2).

system_state_hydration.description: Both clocks, and the behavior-profile values where declared. The reference profile is one prototype; declaring manifold values in a machine-readable record is optional for now, so active_stance and register_coefficients (and the header's protocol) may be omitted (Section 7).

biography_clock.description: UIV plus the ledger commit it was hydrated from: uiv_v[MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH]_commit_[short hash] (Section 5.1).

ledger_mount.description: Where the identity ledger is mounted from. No step of the mount path reads the outgoing UAB (Section 6.3).

head_commit.description: Ledger HEAD. A full git object id is 40 (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256) hex characters.
